summary: Backend-only regression for the two new features: (1) chat_alerts notification-preferences category, (2) orientation flip from 'portrait' to 'default' in app.config.js. All 9 tests in /app/backend/tests/test_chat_alerts_and_orientation.py PASSED against the public preview URL. GET /api/users/me/notification-prefs exposes chat_alerts in both the prefs dict and the categories list, defaulting to True. PATCH round-trips chat_alerts, preserves other categories (class/event/choreographer/mention/reminder_alerts), and ignores unknown keys. A brand-new registered user can read + toggle their own chat_alerts (opt-out semantics). POST /api/chat/messages returns 200 for both admin@stompinground.com and erinboroughs@gmail.com even when the push relay key is a placeholder — no 500. The mention flow returns 'mentioned_user_ids' containing Erin when the message says 'Hi @Erin nice one!'. Direct service-level tests of services.chat_notifications.fan_out_chat_post confirm: poster is excluded, users with chat_alerts=False are excluded, and users listed in already_notified are excluded (so a single '@Erin' message never buzzes Erin twice). app.config.js orientation is 'default'.
critical_code_review_comments: services/chat_notifications.py: fan_out_chat_post correctly layers exclusions in the right order (poster → blocks → prefs filter). Nice defensive try/except around blocks + prefs so a partial failure never spikes the chat POST. Consider logging the final recipient count at DEBUG so ops can trace 'nobody got the push' cases without adding a return-value inspection.

routes/chat.py post_chat swallows exceptions from both fan_out_mentions and fan_out_chat_post with bare `except Exception: pass`. Suggest at least logger.warning(...) inside the except blocks so a systemic push regression isn't silent.

routes/notification_prefs.py PATCH performs a full get→merge→save which is correct for merge-semantics but slightly heavier than a $set on individual keys. Fine at current scale; note for future perf tuning.
core/i18n.py: push.chat_message.title/body templates present across all 8 supported languages — confirmed by inspection. German push.new_dance.body uses proper closing quote U+201C.
seed_data_creation: One TEST_chatalerts_<uuid>@example.com user created via /api/auth/register for opt-out semantics check. Prefixed with TEST_ for later cleanup. Erin's chat_alerts was toggled off then restored to True at end of the fan-out test.
